third._orbit_player: 2026-10-22 14:3x (Eliza, his 'yeah build R6 then 19a'): the space ladder's S13 shape, the first near orbit that started (his 's13 worked'): the orbit has NO conditions and hangs off a Player alias (copied from SE_Player_GenericTemplate) by its parent link, so it is the orbit over the planet he takes the quest on, which for this local Delve is the settlers'. Every way of choosing the orbit by conditions below ('planet', 'system', 'near') never started. The parsec limit is gone with the conditions.
third._orbit: BUILT 2026-10-22 (Eliza, his 'go on 19a, try over'): his MB01 satellite repair's orbit chain, tested IsInSameCurrentLocationAsAlias(the main place, LocTypeMajorOrbital), a space cell at it, and the satellite's marker filled from the cell. So the deliver's at is se_TravelMarkerLocRefB02 (was RECenterLocRef, a surface marker no cell has). No vanilla orbit is tied to a planet this way, so his first play is the proof. 08:0x: "planet" would not start in any map (his), and no log names an alias (startquest bypasses the Story Manager); his "yeah whole system" made it "system": the satellite is somewhere in the settlers' star system, so "over <Planet>" wants rewording (Jessica's) once it starts. 10:4x: "planet" and "system" never started, even after the collection id fix (his "tried a few maps, no luck"), and his own MB01 never ties its orbit to a place: it takes any major orbital body within 8 parsecs of the player. So "near": MB01's conditions verbatim, the limit 1 parsec (his parsec idea for the dungeon). The satellite is somewhere in his system, not forced over the settlers' planet.

place._themes: His settlement at a quiet built site (people there, the reason the relay matters), the raiders at a built hostile site, the satellite overhead.

prose.name: Repairs: Relay Satellite over <Planet>
prose.briefing: The relay satellite over <Planet> went dark, and the settlers at the <Place> have been cut off since. The replacement part never arrived. Raiders took it to the <SecondPlace>.

beats.objective: Talk to the settler at the <Place>
beats.journal: The relay over <Planet> is dead and the settlers at the <Place> can't call anyone. Raiders at the <SecondPlace> took the replacement part, and I need to get it back and fit it.
greeting: No relay means no supply runs, no weather warnings, no doctor. The new core for it got taken by raiders on the way here. If you've got a ship, you're the most useful person I've seen all week.

exchanges.prompt: I'll get the part and fit it.
reply: It's a transceiver core, about the size of a toolbox. Fit it in the satellite and we're back on the network. I'd do it myself if I could fly.
The core burned out. They do, after a few years up there. Everything else on it is fine. Swap the core and it wakes up.

exchanges.prompt: Why does it matter so much?
reply: No relay, no calls. We've been shouting at the sky for nine days.

exchanges.prompt: Could you rig something in the meantime?
reply: I tried. Our set down here can hear the satellite fine. It just won't answer. It's the core or nothing.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 closes the talk and sets the recover's stage. Exchange 3 is a background line in the 18a shape; Cyberneticist is a guess at the right background, Eliza checks the perk id exists. Voiced lines: no names, no places, no factions, no currency.

beats._at: Was LocDungeonBossLocRef until 2026-10-22: a boss-marker second place is almost always a military dungeon (101 of 107), so the quest only started on a map with one close by (32p1 failed, 32p2 on the medium marker played; his: local missions are very map dependent, so there is a cap on the complexity of locations).
beats.objective: Recover the transceiver core from the <SecondPlace>
beats.journal: I took the transceiver core back from the raiders' leader at the <SecondPlace>. I need to fit it in the relay satellite over <Planet>.
say: Got it? It goes to the satellite with no lights on, you can't miss it.

beats.objective: Fit the core in the relay satellite
beats.journal: The relay over <Planet> went dark and raiders at the <SecondPlace> had its replacement core. I got it back and fitted it in orbit. The settlers at the <Place> can call out again.
beats.name: Relay Satellite
say: There it is, we can call out again. Thank you.

message.title: Relay Restored
message.text: The core seats with a click. A row of lights comes on down the satellite's spine, one at a time, and the channel opens.

broadcast: Our relay's dead and we can't call out, so this is going out on a slate. We need someone with a ship.
_speech: Same voice on the radio and in person. The broadcast says short-range on purpose: with the relay dead, nobody far off could hear it. CwhRBWXzGAHq8TQ4Fs17 is the docs' Relay Control example voice; his ear decides.
